helen_customer: Hey team — customer on our API (region eu-west-1) reports that when they use JSON mode with streaming they often get a truncated object. Last two chars usually missing (\"}\"). Happens ~15% of requests, spikes during high load. Repro steps attached.
cleo_support: thanks Helen — can you paste the minimal repro curl and the raw bytes you see? any proxy in front of Redwood?
helen_customer: they have an internal nginx reverse proxy + a CDN. repro curl:
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"mode\":\"json\",\"prompt\":\"...\",\"stream\":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/generate
```
response stream ends like:
```
data: {\"id\":\"abc\",\"object\":\"response\",\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"...\",\"json_fragment\":\"{\\\"answer\\\": \\\"ok\\\"}\"},\"finish_reason\":null}]}

# connection closed by server here (no trailing '}}')
```
oliver_dev: ugh. does the client get a TCP FIN or just EOF on the socket? can you capture `tcpdump -w` or a server-side connection log?
sam_sre: also confirm if keepalive probes are set lower than our chunk interval — nginx default `proxy_read_timeout` is 60s but some customers tweak to 30s, that can cut mid-chunk.
helen_customer: we captured a pcap: the server sent final data then a RST from the proxy ~200ms after the last bytes. sharing pcap link (internal).
cleo_support: hm RST -> likely proxy abort. two follow-ups: 1) can you try bypassing the proxy (direct to our endpoint) to confirm? 2) increase `proxy_read_timeout` and `proxy_buffer_size` to avoid splitting event boundaries.
oliver_dev: for our side, I want the request/response sizes. also logging: we should surface an event when a streaming session ends with non-EOF (i.e. client/proxy reset) so customers can correlate. filing infra ticket.
helen_customer: direct-to-redwood -> no truncation. when going through proxy we see truncation.
sam_sre: that nails it. likely nginx is hitting a buffer/window and deciding to RST on keepalive mismatch when response frames are longer than its buffer. quick mitigation: set `proxy_buffering off;` and bump `proxy_read_timeout 300s;` and `proxy_busy_buffers_size` higher.
cleo_support: also asked the customer to add a tiny keepalive heartbeat in their pipeline to avoid long idle gaps between SSE chunks (a single `:\n` comment every 10s). that avoids some proxies closing idle connections.
oliver_dev: i'm attaching a minimal server-side tweak we can make as a short-term mitigation: emit a single `\n` comment every 8s when streaming structured JSON mode so intermediaries see activity and don't close. will spike token counts slightly but reduces truncation. raising a PR to opt-in via `stream_heartbeat` flag.
ingest-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-431, priority: P2, tags: streaming,json,truncation,proxy.
cleo_support: summary for the customer: root cause is proxy-induced connection reset mid-chunk (seen RST). repro: direct ok -> proxy fails. mitigation options: proxy config changes (timeout/buffering) OR enable short SSE heartbeats OR route through dedicated connection pool. We're cc'ing eng-infra (oliver) to track a product-side safe default (opt-in flag).
helen_customer: thanks — i'll try the proxy tweaks and report back. :thumbsup:
cleo_support: thanks Helen — keep us posted. marking this thread escalated to eng-infra. :pray:
